profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer at Autodesk
profile.summary:
Developer/architect for streaming video clients on Javascript, iOS, Android and Roku platforms.  Responsibilities include development, architectural analysis, manage code releases.

Software architect for a cable receiver project.  Responsibilities include requirements capture, solution design and troubleshooting.

Member of the software integration team for a US cable project.  Produce builds, investigate field issues, work with customer, delivery group and architects to realize and troubleshoot new features.

Manager of user interface component for satellite receiver.  Coordinated release schedules with other component teams.

Team lead.  Worked with manager to coordinate work done in the local office.  Involved in the architectural discussions of new features.

Embedded developer.  Developed software in C and Java for satellite receivers as part of an international development team.  Developed software in C for an embedded power supply controller based around a PIC microcontroller.

Performance analysis.  Analyzed overall system performance to locate bottlenecks and find remedies to improve performance.  Experienced with performance analysis tools for profiling Java and C programs.  Examples of improvements:

SQL query: Located and rewrote problematic SQL queries that cause web-based login to take too long

system-wide investigation: Identified a keyword search/highlight package as the bottleneck in an email dissemination system

pre-sales: Analyzed queries used on special-purpose hardware to give a customer an estimate of how these queries would perform on the new version of the hardware.  The customer upgraded their system to the new hardware.

Specialties: embedded software, performance tuning, defect investigation

positions.title: Software Architect - Infinite Video project
positions.description: Architect and develop client software for viewing streaming video.  The bulk of my development work is on our HTML5 client, with some work on Android, iOS and Roku.  I work as a developer/team lead with two other developers on a Javascript SDK.  I configure and maintain the CI pipeline, build infrastructure and lead the effort to implement unit testing on the SDK.

positions.title: Software Architect - Cable TV project
positions.description:
Work with customers to capture and document requirements, understand business scenarios and capture in architecture documentation.

Work with development and QA teams to design a solutions to implement/test new functionality and address defects.

positions.title: English teacher
positions.description: Assistant language teacher in rural Nagasaki Prefecture.  Helped students learn correct English pronunciation, created classroom materials and planned activities.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineer:
Developer for "Paracel Today", a web application for custom news filtering.

On-site and on-call remote support for the website after its launch.

Participated in design of hardware systems several Paracel hardware products.

Wrote embedded software for power supply and temperature monitoring for 4 different Paracel hardware platforms.

Developed software used in the paracel GM2 for programming FPGA chips via JTAG bus.

Developed diagnostic routines to detect defective components in the Paracel FDF4 and GM2 systems.

Designed and implemented manufacturing process to configure a specialized Solaris install for a Paracel system.

Investigated new operating modes for the Paracel GM2 to improve system performance.

Evaluated and supported third party JBOD and RAID disk systems.

positions.title: intern
positions.description:
Sound response developed interactive voice response (IVR) applications.  Various projects I did at Sound Response:

Wrote and maintained monitoring software to detect crashed servers

Built a hardware solution to retrieve messages onto audio tape for transcription

Wrote and optimized a search application to locate the nearest stores given a zip code

Supported a remote data center with scripting, workflow and some system administration tasks
